E2eeCaps.description:
What the joining client can do (S50 §9.1 K1, S51 §16 item 4). The server refuses an
incapable client with `422 e2ee_unsupported_client` (§11.3 J1), so the values themselves are
not checked here, only their sizes.

ciphersuites.description: MLS ciphersuites the client supports (S51 §6.1.1); must contain 1 when present.

key_ring_size.description: 64 (rev 75); anything else is refused at join.

sdk_version.description: The SDK version as its `ClientInfo` reports it.

sender_key_index.description: The SDK can move its sender to a new key slot.

E2eeJoin.description:
The `e2ee` object of a voice or call join (K1; S33 v2 `VoiceJoinRequest.e2ee`, S34 v2's call
joins).

key_package_ref.description: The single-use ref K16 returned (32 bytes).

RecordingNotice.description:
The answer to the consent modal, sent with a voice join or call join/accept (§9.4, §9.10).
Joining never implies consent: `consent` is required and `notice_version` must echo the
current [`ConsentPrompt`].

consent.description: The person's answer. Missing → `400 validation_failed`, field `recording_notice.consent`.

notice_version.description: The prompt version the person saw.

e2ee.description:
The key join (S50 K1). Required while voice is enabled; `None` answers
`422 e2ee_unsupported_client` with `details.unsupported = e2ee`.

recording_notice.description: The answer to the recording consent modal (S35 v2 §9.4, §9.10).

self_video.description: Join with a camera lease (S34 v2 §10.2).
